bregenzerwald-furkajoch-faschina-day.title: Bregenzerwald · Furkajoch · Faschina Day
bregenzerwald-furkajoch-faschina-day.slogan: Vorarlberg balcony roads, high meadows and compact pass rhythm.
bregenzerwald-furkajoch-faschina-day.story: Vorarlberg balcony roads, high meadows and compact pass rhythm. Out of Dornbirn and back again: 155 km, roughly 3 h 21 in the saddle. The stops in between: Bregenzerwald villages and Rankweil. The climbs: Faschinajoch high road and Furkajoch pass road. It tops out at 1,761 m. Faschinajoch is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It is a high-mountain day.

scenicChapters.title: Bregenzerwald Cheese Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 29 km this is Bregenzerwald Cheese Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Bregenzerwald Cheese Road
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 37 km. 786 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Furkajoch
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1761 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 21 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
